author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Want to learn how to set up Xero the right way? In this beginner-friendly tutorial, I’ll walk you step-by-step through everything you need to know to get started with Xero, including setting up your dashboard, customizing your chart of accounts, adding tracking categories, creating invoices, managing bills, connecting bank accounts, and exploring Xero’s most powerful reporting tools.

👇 Get started with Xero using our special offer, at time of filming, for 90% off your first six months*: https://referrals.xero.com/ultimatexero 

In this video, you’ll learn how to: 
• Set up your Xero account from scratch
• How to tailor Xero for property management, including tracking rent, owner payouts, and security deposits
• Customize your Chart of Accounts
• How to use Tracking Categories to monitor profit & loss by property, store location, or service provider
• How to create invoice templates, recurring invoices, and product/service lists
• How to upload bills, track expenses, and connect bank
title: Xero for Beginners
